## Editor’s Note

When Mara wrote, “We’ll reopen on May 1—if the permits arrive,” the staff copied the line exactly; later drafts replaced the smart quotes and collapsed the non-breaking spaces around the date.

The printed notice read, “Members only—no guests after 9 p.m.”—a small change, but one that mattered to the front desk team.

issues.description: The heading apostrophe was normalized from curly to straight: `Editor’s Note` became `Editor's Note`.
Smart quotes/apostrophes were replaced with straight ASCII quotes in both paragraphs, changing intended punctuation and typography.
Em dashes were incorrectly converted to hyphens in both quoted phrases and before `a small change`, altering the intended punctuation.
Non-breaking spaces in `May 1` and `after 9 p.m.` were collapsed to regular spaces, losing the intended no-wrap behavior.
